title: Recording: 1882 by Wings | 1972
content:
Studio Two, EMI Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Alan Parsons

Wings recorded a studio version of ‘1882’ on 13 November 1972.

Paul McCartney had considered releasing a live recording from the Wings Over Europe Tour, and spent the previous four days overseeing stereo mixes from the final five concerts.

Unsatisfied with the results, he led Wings through four takes of the song on this day, none of which were complete. Takes 3 and 4 were edited together to become a master version, but this was shelved and never released. Early iterations of Red Rose Speedway contained a live recording from Berlin, but this was omitted from the final release.
